responsibility: Implements a concrete logical_locations::manager for diagnostics selftests. This file maps simple function-name strings to stable test logical-location keys, returns those names through the manager virtuals, and provides the small selftest suite verifying the mapping, so test path and SARIF logic can exercise logical-location features without depending on GCC tree-based logical locations.
same_name_distinction: Implements the test_manager declared in selftest-logical-locations.h, including name-to-item allocation, virtual method definitions, and the file-local selftests that verify the mapping. Unlike the header, this .cc provides both the concrete behavior and its verification code.
